We’re a small independent group of photographers, designers, and engineers who want more out of their camera: more natural shots, more cinematic video, and more manual controls. We’ve been making MPC-II for over a decade and promise to keep making it better. Join us. NATURAL, UNPROCESSED SHOTS It starts with the look. • MPC-II offers our own Natural Processing imaging pipeline. It builds from RAW data instead of the stock camera’s heavier HDR and contrast, so you get authentic tones without excessive sharpening and noise reduction. • Dynamic Range Enhancer: a tone mapping pipeline for Natural that recovers detail in highlights and shadows. Set it to Off, Light, Medium, or Strong. • Import Your LUTs: bring your own into the Look Library and organize them in folders. Shoot with your LUTs baked into your shots, or use them in preview-only mode. YOUR OWN WORKFLOW Your camera, your way. We built MPC-II to support anyone’s workflow. • Swap Your Action Plates: pick the plate that suits you, then choose which controls live on it. Rearrange the controls or remove everything but the capture mode. • Save Your Profiles: save your capture mode, format, look, and controls. Store unlimited profiles and pin four to quick slots you switch with a tap. • Launch From Anywhere: open a Profile or capture mode from a widget, a Shortcut, or Apple Watch. On the Watch you also get a live feed, lens switching, Crown zoom, and timers. • Your Focal Lengths: add the focal lengths you actually shoot to each camera and cycle through them from the lens bar. • Zen Mode: go distraction-free. PRO TOOLS Now for the camera-nerd features. We’ve spent a decade building pro tools that photographers and filmmakers rely on. Missing one? Tell us and we’ll add it. • All The Manual Controls: Auto, Shutter Priority with ISO range, ISO priority, or full Manual. White balance by temperature and tint, presets, or gray card. Separate exposure and focus reticles, Manual Focus, Focus Peaking, and Focus Loupe. On iPhone 18 Pro, Variable Aperture from f1.48 to f4.0. Works in Photo and Video. • Photo Modes: Natural, Standard, RAW, or ProRAW. JPG, HEIF, or TIFF. Standard at 12, 24, or 48MP. Shoot 3:4, 4:5, 1:1, or 16:9. Tune ProRAW bit depth and compression. • Video Modes: Open Gate, Apple Log and Log2, ProRes, 10-bit recording, and HEVC. Set resolution, color space, frame rate, codec, bitrate, and chroma subsampling. • Slow Shutter: build light trails and motion blur in camera by stacking frames. Set a duration, or hold the exposure open with Bulb. • Monitoring: Waveform, RGB histograms, zebras, false color, and audio meters. Grids, levels, and social frames. • Hardware and Storage: save to your photo library, Files, or external storage. Supports external and bluetooth mics, HDMI clean feed, and Moment lenses with anamorphic de-squeeze. BUILT TO BE RELIED ON We track our performance closely. Whether you’re shooting from a mountaintop or making a feature film, MPC-II is an app you can count on when it matters most. • Efficient processing: our pipeline is built to perform, even when shooting high-bandwidth formats with monitors and LUTs. • Confidence: your selected lens is locked, rather than switching on its own when the light changes. Your format, exposure, and color settings stay on screen, so you always know what you're shooting. • Always reliable: a stable app you can count on through the whole take, the whole shoot, and the whole trip. We love hearing from our community. For feature requests, ideas, or support, email us at hello@momentprocamera.com or message us @momentprocamera on social media. Application Description

Groundwire: the SIP softphone for your PBX or VoIP provider Groundwire is a SIP softphone app from Acrobits, a leader in VoIP and communication software since 2009. It delivers clear voice and video calls for personal and professional use, with an interface built for daily calling and none of the clutter. IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ Groundwire is a SIP client, not a VoIP service. You need service from a VoIP provider or PBX that supports standard SIP clients. Business calling features Groundwire carries the call handling you expect from a desk phone: - Group calls, for conferencing several people into one conversation. - Attended transfers, so you can announce a caller before handing the call over. - Unattended transfers, when the caller just needs the right extension. - Voicemail with notifications, so a missed call still reaches you. - Instant messaging, for the things that do not need a call. - Per-account settings, so one device carries several SIP identities cleanly. Works with your PBX or VoIP provider Groundwire is a universal client and true VoIP for PBX users. Teams run it as an Asterisk softphone, a FreePBX extension, or a 3CX endpoint, and it connects just as readily to hosted PBX systems and business phone providers. It also comes preconfigured for major providers, so setup takes minutes. Because it is a standard client, there is no lock-in: bring the account you already have, and Groundwire becomes the mobile extension of your PBX, with encrypted SIP calling on every network. On a team it is the business softphone dialer sitting on top of the PBX you already pay for. On your own it keeps a work line separate, or carries a desk extension in your pocket. Key features of the softphone - Audio on widely used codecs, Opus, G.729 and G.711 among them. - Video calls at 720p HD, carried by H.264 and VP8. - Private conversations with military-grade encryption, including TLS, SRTP, and ZRTP. - Low battery use thanks to efficient push notifications. - The VoIP dialer hands calls over between WiFi and mobile data without dropping them. - Custom call settings, UI, and ringtones per account. - 5G ready and compatible with most mobile operating systems. A softphone app without the fees Groundwire is a softphone for calling over WiFi and mobile data, with the business dialer features that usually cost a monthly fee. One payment, no subscription, nothing hidden: buy it once and it stays yours. Encryption sits inside that price rather than on top of it. Run a call center, manage a fleet of extensions, or keep a dependable sip phone for a home office. The same app covers all of it, without extra tiers. Download Groundwire and put a dependable SIP dialer on your phone, with Acrobits engineering and responsive support behind it.

Application Description

AI 時代還要學程式設計嗎？事實是要，但已經不是過去的學習方式，怎麼說呢？以前的老前輩總是要學初學者先掌握一門程式語言，這裡所謂的掌握，拿 C 語言來舉例，就是要到能開發出 C 語言編譯器甚至到用 C 語言寫出作業系統，所以程式設計專科像是資訊工程系的課程就是這樣安排。 換句話說，過去的觀念強調用背誦培養，不管學生懂不懂，反正學生不懂也是可以先背起來，很多前輩的求學歷程不外都是先背了一堆知識，等到了未來某一天見到了某個知識點，才總算觸類旁通，以前不懂的，才在突然懂了，也就是到了特定知識點才對程式設計開竅。 先記住等到以後才弄懂的模式，坦白說是要在戰後快速培養人才，這樣記性好、學習效率高，也就是遴選出智商高的人才，問題是記性不等於悟性，所以記住是記住，卻不等於理解到懂的程度。 這就導致一種很詭異的現象，智商高的人記住了但是不懂，結果就是一直耍小聰明，賣弄他記住的知識，卻難以真正做創造或發明的工作，其實現在的 AI 幾乎可以說是就是智商極高的智能體， AI 可以依據提示詞做推論，但也僅只於推論而已，正確與否或是否符合需求則需要由另一套機制驗證。 所以 AI 強在可以跟你講知識，依據你輸入的文字推論你想要的結果，但目前的 AI 無法體察你言語間細微的變化，也無法分辨你言語的意思是否是 AI 能夠理解的意思，換句話說沒辦法察言觀色，也就是 AI 理解不了你懂或是不懂，或是你的理解與 AI 的理解是否相同，結果是你讓智商高的 AI 一直賣弄小聰明，向你堆知識，瞬間給你座圖書館，這就引出真正的難題，你不懂就不會用，你能做的頂多是跟 AI 一樣，依樣畫葫蘆，如果你不想畫一樣的葫蘆，你還是得懂。 正因為是弄懂了才會用，從另一種角度來講，懂了才知道要去記什麼，從而長出記性，多年的教學經驗給我的感受是讓多數學習程式設計的人，恍然大悟的知識點是弄懂產品的概念，換言之，從前是先學什麼是程式，從程式慢慢擴張到軟體，再從軟體的角度去學開發產品，這時候軟體規格到整個軟體的架構才出來，然後才懂得程式只是零件，所以說到頭，軟體開發是有了基本的邏輯概念後，去寫構成零件的程式，然後才能去組合零件到產品。 所以本 App 的設計理念反其道而行，從產品的角度出發，總共分成四個部份 基礎學習篇 軟體開發篇 GUI 篇 Brython 篇 「基礎學習篇」著重帶領學習者寫 Python 的小程式，藉此熟悉 Python 的語法，目的不是為了精通 Python 程式語言，而是為了「軟體開發篇」做準備。「軟體開發篇」從軟體規格出發，重點是繼續帶領學習者進一步開發能把英文句子編密碼的 Encrypt 類別。 Encrypt 類別作為「GUI 篇」的計算核心，繼續帶領學習者用 Tk 製作「編密碼小工具」的 GUI 視窗軟體。 -geany- 「Brython 篇」則是藉由第三方程式庫 Brython ，繼續把「邊密碼小工具」移植到網頁上。換言之，「編密碼小工具」就是本 App 依教學需求所開發的產品，這是一個宏觀的角度，先理解軟體的架構，再回推需要補強學習之處，畢竟現在電腦早已不再是先寫編譯器才能讓程式運作，也就是說，目的是讓學習者能先弄懂軟體開發是怎麼一回事，懂了軟體開發，往後再由其他管道，例如 AI 補強語法細節。 現階段 AI 還是一個提示詞給一組回應，當然也可以用如 agent 排程去做，講到提示詞就跟過去指令一樣，換句話說還沒走出自動化程式那一套， Python 就是適合在系統中寫自動化程式工作的程式語言。 有沒有發現一件事情，現在的 AI 是利用自然語言將工作自動化，但是維護能做自動化工作的 agent ，還是需要程式設計師，相對是要求經驗更豐富程式設計師，因此想要當程式設計師，就需要不斷的強化程式設計能力，如果能先弄懂軟體開發是什麼一回事，再來的程式語言的語法細節到電腦底層邏輯，本來很枯燥要死背的東西，一下子就變成有趣了起來。 有趣，學習才有意義，不是嗎？況且要自己手動寫出能跑得程式碼才有成就感，如果像前些日子從網路抄程式碼到現在跟 AI 要程式碼，那其實都不太會產生成就的快感，而且可能需要一直懊惱的除錯，說到這裡，無論網路或 AI 都是寶劍，你手持寶劍是要斬妖除魔，但如果你被寶劍反制控制住你的心靈，寶劍就無法成為你自身力量的延伸，那還不如棄之不用。 最後感謝購買本 App ，但由於每個人的基礎不同，希望本 App 設計的教學方式能對學習程式設計有所幫助。懂不是一件容易的事，但是總是要懂了才知道要怎麼做，做了才會有真正的幫助。 張凱慶 2026/05/13

Esquecidos por todos exceto Henry Dijon e sua maluca equipe de arqueológos. Eles saíram de Marte para escavar tesouros perdidos no selvagem e inabitável Planeta Terra. Tudo corre bem até o professor de Henry ser raptado e as coisas começarem a ficar… esquisitas. Junte-se a Henry em uma aventura através das ruínas de nossa civilização. Faça perguntas como "Quem foi Sony Walkman? Por onde ele andava?" Descubra relíquias extraordinárias, resgate o Professor Totel e seja o primeiro a entrar na lendária cidade de Mutropolis. Mais uma coisa - os deuses do antigo Egito são reais e estão tentando destruir a humanidade. - Divirta-se!
